summary: Tested the two new Nubo Express features end-to-end: (1) AI Smart Search on Customer dashboard and (2) Admin Dashboard with stats + active drivers. All backend tests (11/11) pass and the critical frontend flows pass. Google Maps InvalidKeyMapError is the documented external API-key issue and is intentionally not reported as a bug.

issues: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning in console)

action_items: (External, NOT a code bug) Replace REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY in frontend/.env with a valid key that has Maps JavaScript API + billing enabled to make the admin live map render. Code is correct.
(Minor a11y) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to product DialogContent in CustomerDashboard to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: smart_search() correctly falls back to top-3 businesses when LLM parsing fails (defensive). Good.
Admin endpoints correctly enforce role=='admin' and return 403 otherwise; _id is properly excluded from Mongo projections.
PATCH /api/drivers/location correctly checks role=='driver' (403 otherwise) and persists current_location + timestamp.
Auth /register does not return a JWT token, only the user doc. Not breaking (frontend likely calls login after), but worth noting for API consumers.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@nuboexpress.com / Admin1234; Driver: bee.madrid@nubo.com / Driver1234; freshly registered customer per run
seed_data_creation: Ran /app/backend/seed_admin.py (idempotent) to refresh 7 demo drivers' availability+locations before testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_and_smart_search.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Frontend testids verified: admin-dashboard, admin-stats-grid (6 cards), admin-driver-list (7 drivers), smart-search-card, smart-search-input, smart-search-btn, smart-search-results, smart-result-{id}. Auth flow: /auth → login-form with login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-btn; register tab has register-email-input/register-password-input/register-name-input/register-phone-input/register-submit-btn. After login the app routes admin role to AdminDashboard via /dashboard. Google Maps key is intentionally invalid in this env — do not flag.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs detected. Only known external Google Maps API key limitation, already documented in test_credentials.md.
